In [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Sant|mythology]], '''Ruul''' was the life goddess and the twin sister of the warrior [[Luur]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] helped to watch the prison of [[Quay'va]].<ref name="LoNH" />
